CustomField.description: Which component published this report: Worker (the worker's own finalizer), Replay Guard (the dispatch was rejected as stale), Dispatch (the worker trigger could not enqueue the shard), or Watchdog (CursorBatchStalledJobWatchdog presuming that a silent worker failed). CursorBatchCompletionHandler counts Watchdog reports only while the job still has workers unaccounted for, because they are a presumption rather than a record of what happened. Blank on events published before v0.37, which are treated as Worker.
CustomField.label: Reported By
